title: A relation-incidence proof of Tohăneanu's low-exponent supersolvability conjecture
description: Every finite central free hyperplane arrangement over a characteristic-zero field whose nonzero exponents are 1 or 2 with at most one 3 is supersolvable. This research note proves the full conjecture in Tohăneanu's Oberwolfach contribution using linear-relation formality, rank-two counts, a forced K4 incidence core and modular terminal-pencil extensions. The paper credits the earlier all-2, tree, rank-three and modular-pruning results and acknowledges Ferudun's matching October 12, 2026 preprint. The verification archive preserves the October 4 PR candidate and dated disclosure records, source/priority audits and reproducible exact computational diagnostics. No exhaustive first-priority or independent-development claim is made. AI tools were used extensively in solving, writing and verifying the work. This is an unrefereed preprint; internal AI reviews do not constitute independent human peer review.
